itens.titulo: Galaxy Research Warns Bitcoin Could Fall to $28,200 if June Low Breaks
itens.descricao: Galaxy Research Warns Bitcoin Could Fall to $28,200 if June Low Breaks Yahoo Finance
trechos: Galaxy Research (Nasdaq: $GLXY) has withdrawn its October prediction that Bitcoin's (CRYPTO: $BTC) bear market ended in June, warning that a break below the $58,525 daily closing low could open the door to a much deeper decline.
In a recent report, the firm said Bitcoin's recovery above its 50-week moving average had failed.
BTC spent seven weeks above the indicator after reclaiming it in September, but closed below it in the week ended November 8.
The following week, it also fell below its 200-week moving average, which has historically acted as a floor during bear markets.
Bitcoin dropped as low as $55,100 over the weekend on Saturday, breaking its July intraday low.
However, its daily closing low of $58,525 from June 30 remained intact through Sunday, when BTC closed at $61,104.
In seven previous cases where Bitcoin closed below a low that had held for at least 60 days after a 20% rebound, the eventual bottom was at least 17% lower.
The median decline was 51.8%, which would put Bitcoin near $28,200 if the pattern repeated from $58,525.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin Tops $60,000 as Risk Assets Rise in Holiday Trading
itens.descricao: Bitcoin Tops $60,000 as Risk Assets Rise in Holiday Trading Yahoo Finance
trechos: (Bloomberg) -- Bitcoin (BTC-USD) rose above the $60,000 mark on Thursday as risky assets tracked a rebound in tech equities, pushing crypto markets higher as they head into a period of thin holiday trading.
"The rebound has improved the tape," analysts at Marex wrote in a note Thursday.

"It has not repaired the underlying demand picture." A set of US exchange-traded funds tracking the price of Bitcoin recorded $453 million in outflows on Wednesday, taking the group's outflows over the past month above $5 billion.
The products launched to great fanfare in January 2024, but performance has faltered under dampened demand for the underlying asset.

itens.titulo: Lumentum Surges 55% in a Year: Should You Buy, Sell, or Hold the Stock?
itens.descricao: Lumentum Surges 55% in a Year: Should You Buy, Sell, or Hold the Stock? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Lumentum LITE shares have surged 54.6% in a year, outperforming the broader Zacks Computer and Technology sector's decline of 1.4%.
Applied Optoelectronics and Coherent shares have rallied 44.8% and 27.4%, respectively, over the past year.
Strong hyperscaler spending, growing adoption of 1.6T optical transceivers, optical circuit switches (OCS) and next-generation laser technologies are strengthening Lumentum's growth prospects.
In the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Lumentum's revenues surged 136.5% year over year to $1.26 billion, with pump lasers and OCS driving most of the growth.
Components revenues increased 98.9% year over year to $754.2 million, while Systems revenues jumped 228.8% to $508.4 million.
The company secured its second major NPO/CPO design win, backed by purchase commitments exceeding $5 billion.
Moreover, strengthening demand visibility for OCS positions optical switching to become a multibillion-dollar annual revenue opportunity.
In October 2026, Lumentum announced a collaboration with Astera Labs and Corning to demonstrate 1060 nm VCSEL-based PCIe-over-optics connectivity at the 2026 OCP Global Summit.
